n1f250ca692.headline: Relief for investors in Catalonia crisis - no impulse from Rajoy
n1f250ca692.summary: Investors reacted positively to Catalan leader Carles Puigdemont's speech, with Madrid stock prices rising sharply and Spanish government bonds increasing.
